label: Blind sample 006: Hansen forest loss 2022, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2022 (90% interval −0.12 to −0.04). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). The control trajectory tracked the area less closely than usual before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.02); the fit check passed only because the change is more than 4 times that error.

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.14); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −0.7 dB, interval −0.6 to −0.1).
